Add in-cell bars to a flextable

Source: R/flextable.R
phw_flextable_bars.Rd

Draws a small horizontal bar before each value, scaled to the largest value in the column, so readers can compare sizes at a glance (as in many PHW summary tables).

Usage

phw_flextable_bars(
  x,
  j,
  colour = phw_colours[["light_teal"]],
  width = 0.9,
  height = 0.1,
  digits = 0
)

Arguments

x

A flextable.

j

Columns, chosen as in dplyr::select(): unquoted names, positions or strings.

colour

Bar colour.

width, height

Bar size in inches.

digits

Decimal places for the value.

Value

A flextable.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) {
  df <- data.frame(Area = paste("Area", LETTERS[1:4]), Cases = c(120, 85, 64, 19))
  phw_flextable_bars(phw_flextable(df), Cases)
}
